description: Tight capacity — only 8h/week, 2 critical threats, forces painful tradeoffs
notes: With 8h and max_concurrent=2: counter_competitor(9,5h) covers both threats. Best companion: improve_docs(4,3h) or the system picks address_pricing(10,5h) but that busts capacity with counter_competitor. Expected: counter_competitor + improve_docs = 13 value, 8h.
